## Plan and merge request

- Plan ID and requirement IDs
- Requested merge position, dependencies, and owner-approved scope
- Base commit, overlaps, and semantic conflict risks

## Changes

- Implementation or document changes, interfaces, and approved directories
- Actual changed files, scope exclusions, and downstream effects
- Documentation impact and updated bilingual references

## Evidence

- Acceptance scenarios, actual commands, environment, and results
- Build, regression, performance, security, and privacy evidence
- Self-review findings, corrections, and rerun results
- Checks for reintroduced behavior and missing verification
- Errors, blockers, pending decisions, and workspace cleanup

## Owner review

- Approval needed and merge readiness
